protocol.reference_marginal_path: (1 - weight) * interaction-MF own marginal + weight * user-kNN own marginal
protocol.common_marginal: within each outer fold, the mean of the two learned policies' own marginals at the requested own-reference TV
protocol.common_policy: minimum-KL action-intercept projection to the common marginal; score strength calibrated to the requested common-exposure TV
protocol.outcome_access: common-exposure policies use frozen scores only; candidate outcomes are read after calibration
protocol.positive_control_role: uses held-out outcomes as scores, then applies the same common-marginal projection and TV calibration; it is not learned or deployable and is not claimed to be the best policy under the two constraints
protocol.user_bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap over users after averaging each user's frozen-policy value gap over split seeds
protocol.reference_path_bootstrap: the same resampled users are used at every common-marginal weight; simultaneous bands use the maximum absolute centered bootstrap deviation over the path
protocol.shared_quality_negative_control: constructed shared-score control equals the interaction-only MF score plus a fold-specific action-only item-quality term; common-exposure projection should remove this term exactly
protocol.fixed_marginal_strength_path: for each outcome, one midpoint marginal is built at the anchor TV and held fixed while policy TV changes
protocol.kl_strength_sensitivity: for each main TV cell, hold its common marginal fixed; set the outcome-free KL target to the mean KL of the two equal-TV projected policies, then recalibrate both frozen scores to equal mean KL from the marginal
protocol.factor_hyperparameter_sensitivity: for complete watch, keep each split's primary MF-kNN midpoint marginal and TV fixed, then vary MF rank and ridge
protocol.knn_hyperparameter_sensitivity: for complete watch, keep each split's primary MF and nested-selected-kNN midpoint marginal and TV fixed, then evaluate every fixed neighborhood fraction
